_comment: Astral Core Memory plugin manifest for OpenClaw 2026.3.31+. Declares kind=memory at the manifest level (required for before_prompt_build dispatch) and mirrors the configSchema from index.ts in JSON Schema form so OpenClaw can validate user config in openclaw.json.

serverUrl.label: Memory Server URL
serverUrl.help: URL of the Astral Core Memory API server. Default port 8090.

autoCapture.label: Auto-Capture
autoCapture.help: Automatically capture conversations through the surprise-gated MASK pipeline.

autoRecall.label: Auto-Recall
autoRecall.help: Automatically inject relevant memories into the agent's system prompt before each turn.

maxRecallMemories.label: Max Recall Memories
maxRecallMemories.help: Maximum number of memories to inject per prompt (1-20).

minSimilarity.label: Minimum Similarity
minSimilarity.help: Minimum cosine similarity for memory recall (0.0-1.0). Raised from 0.3 to 0.45 in v2.0.0 to reduce noisy dormant reactivation.

captureMinMessages.label: Capture Min Messages
captureMinMessages.help: Minimum messages in a turn before attempting capture.

captureMaxChars.label: Capture Max Chars
captureMaxChars.help: Maximum characters to send for capture per turn.

briefingCardOnStart.label: Briefing Card on Session Start
briefingCardOnStart.help: Inject a concise summary of identity facts and active context on the first turn of each session.

briefingMaxTokens.label: Briefing Max Tokens
briefingMaxTokens.help: Maximum tokens for the briefing card (50-500).

fortressUrl.label: Orbital Fortress URL
fortressUrl.help: Orbital Fortress URL for fleet sync. Leave empty to disable.

healthCheckOnStart.label: Health Check on Start
healthCheckOnStart.help: Check memory server health when the plugin loads.

verboseHooks.label: Verbose Hooks (Diagnostic)
verboseHooks.help: Log every hook invocation at INFO level with dispatch context. Enable when diagnosing hook-routing issues. Adds approximately 5-8 log lines per agent turn. Safe to leave off in production.
